description: Complete rebuild of Alex Swearingen's portfolio as a cel-shaded 3D garage environment with interactive career stations
completedStories: US-001 through US-061 completed - see git history for details

userStories.title: Audio mute toggle UI
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to control audio with a button.
acceptanceCriteria: Add mute/unmute button in corner of screen
Button shows speaker icon (muted/unmuted state)
Clicking toggles audio state
Style button to match UI theme
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill - button toggles correctly
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Procedural sound effects
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want subtle sound effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement footstep sound: short noise burst on movement (throttled)
Implement UI click: short blip on modal open/close
Implement ambient hum: low oscillator drone (very quiet)
All sounds procedurally generated, no audio files
Sounds are subtle background level, not jarring
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill - sounds enhance without annoying
Iterate on frequencies and volumes until pleasant
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Robot idle animation
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want the robot to feel alive when standing still.
acceptanceCriteria: Create js/systems/animation.js for robot animations
Idle animation plays when robot is not moving
Gentle bobbing motion: robot bobs up/down slightly (sine wave, ~0.05 units amplitude)
Subtle breathing: body scales slightly on Y axis (1.0 to 1.02)
Antenna sways gently side to side
Eyes/visor can have subtle glow pulse
Animation is smooth and loops seamlessly
Register animation update in game loop
Verify in browser - robot feels alive and charming when idle
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Robot walk animation
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see the robot animate when moving.
acceptanceCriteria: Walk animation plays when robot is moving (based on movement input)
Legs alternate forward/back rotation (swing ~20-30 degrees)
Arms swing opposite to legs (natural walk cycle)
Body has slight bounce (up/down with each step)
Head bobs slightly with movement
Animation speed scales with movement speed
Smooth transition from idle to walk and back
Verify in browser - walk cycle looks natural and charming
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Jump system mechanics
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to make the robot jump with spacebar.
acceptanceCriteria: Track spacebar press in controls.js
Add jump state tracking: isGrounded, isJumping, verticalVelocity
Jump constants in constants.js: JUMP_FORCE (~12), GRAVITY (~30), GROUND_Y (0)
Pressing space when grounded applies upward velocity
Gravity pulls robot down each frame (velocity -= gravity * deltaTime)
Robot lands when Y <= ground level, reset to grounded state
Cannot jump while already in air (no double jump)
Horizontal movement still works while jumping
Verify in browser - spacebar makes robot jump with arc trajectory
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Robot jump animation
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want the robot to animate during jumps.
acceptanceCriteria: Jump anticipation: slight crouch/squash before leaving ground (scale Y to 0.9)
Ascent pose: legs tucked, arms up, body stretched (scale Y to 1.1)
Peak pose: brief hang time feel at apex
Descent pose: legs extend down, preparing to land
Landing squash: compress on impact (scale Y to 0.85), then spring back
Smooth transitions between all jump phases
Jump animation overrides walk/idle while in air
Verify in browser - jump feels bouncy and satisfying
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Platforming elements - crates and boxes
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want platforms to jump on around the garage.
acceptanceCriteria: Create createPlatform(position, size) function in garage.js or new platforms.js
Platforms use voxel BoxGeometry aesthetic matching robot style
Add 3-5 stackable crates/boxes at various heights around garage
Crate positions: near workbench, by shelving, stacked in corner
Heights vary: some at 1 unit, some at 2 units, some stacked to 3 units
All platforms have black inverted hull outlines
Platforms use wood or cardboard toon material
Register collision boxes for all platforms
Verify in browser - platforms look like garage storage crates
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Platform collision and landing
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to land on platforms when jumping.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend collision system to track platform heights
When robot is above a platform and falling, land on top of it
Ground level becomes platform top when standing on one
Can jump from platform to platform
Walking off edge of platform causes fall
Smooth landing detection (not jittery)
Robot can still walk on ground level (Y=0)
Verify in browser - can jump onto crates and walk on them
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Ceiling fan spin animation
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want the ceiling fan to spin continuously.
acceptanceCriteria: Ceiling fan rotates on Y axis at constant speed (~0.03 rad/frame)
Register fan animation in game loop
Fan casts rotating shadow on floor (adds life to scene)
Rotation is smooth, not jittery
Verify in browser - fan spins smoothly overhead
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Note: This may overlap with US-046, consolidate if needed

userStories.title: Ambient garage animations
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want subtle animations bringing the garage to life.
acceptanceCriteria: Flickering light effect: occasional subtle brightness variation on main light
Tool wobble: small tools on workbench have micro-wobble animation
Dust particles drift slowly (if US-051 implemented, enhance it)
Clock or gauge needle moves slowly (if applicable)
All animations are subtle and don't distract from gameplay
Performance: ambient animations should be cheap (<1ms total per frame)
Verify in browser - garage feels alive without being distracting
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Station interaction animations
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want stations to react when I approach or interact.
acceptanceCriteria: Stations glow or pulse subtly when robot is in proximity
Interaction trigger (E press) causes brief 'activation' animation
Activation could be: scale bounce, color flash, particle burst
Each station type can have unique reaction (hologram spins faster, record scratches, etc.)
Animations are quick and responsive (not slow/sluggish)
Verify in browser - stations feel interactive and responsive
Typecheck passes
